تستعرين (form VIII)
# تَسْتَعِرِينَ (tastaʕirīna) /tas.ta.ʕi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
# تُسْتَعَرِينَ (tustaʕarīna) /tus.ta.ʕa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
